name: Proving Your Worth
summary: In Duskwood, Sven Yorgen tests your strength before he lets you face Morbent Fel. The hermit seeks revenge for his family and needs proof you can overcome the undead at Raven Hill Cemetery.

sections.title: A Bitter Hermit's Test
sections.body: At a secluded camp north of the howling woods, Sven Yorgen grieves for his family and burns with fury over their slaughter. He has learned that the Dark Riders who destroyed his homestead were allied with the necromancer Morbent Fel. Sven wants revenge, but he will not send an untried ally straight into Fel's grasp. First, he asks you to prove your combat skill against the skeletal forces at Raven Hill Cemetery.

sections.title: The Raven Hill Crypts
sections.body: Raven Hill Cemetery lies south of Forlorn Rowe, and its grounds and mausoleum crawl with corpses bound by Fel's magic. Skeletal Raiders patrol among the tombstones with swords, while Skeletal Warders and Healers tend the chambers below. To earn Sven's trust, you must push deep into the necropolis and clear this vanguard. Mor'Ladim, a vengeful phantom, prowls the cemetery paths.

sections.title: The Road to the Necromancer
sections.body: Surviving Raven Hill's catacombs convinces Sven that you have more than courage. Fel's lesser minions are only the first obstacle. Morbent Fel's dark enchantments protect him from ordinary weapons, so Sven seeks greater wisdom and ancient relics before the final confrontation.

faq.q: Why does Sven make me fight skeletons before facing Morbent Fel?
aliases: why sven makes me kill skeletons
faq.answer: Sven knows Morbent Fel is a deadly necromancer allied with the mysterious Dark Riders. He will not send you to face him until you show you can fight through a vanguard of undead.

faq.q: Where are the Skeletal Warders and Healers found?
faq.answer: Skeletal Raiders patrol the open cemetery south of Forlorn Rowe. Skeletal Healers and Warders gather in and around the large mausoleum and the crypt tunnels west of the cemetery's center.

faq.q: Who is Mor'Ladim and why should I watch out for him here?
faq.answer: Mor'Ladim is a powerful undead knight who roams Raven Hill Cemetery. He is far stronger than the ordinary skeletons and can quickly cut down the unwary.

faq.q: How is Morbent Fel connected to the Dark Riders?
faq.answer: Sven learned that Morbent Fel allied with the cloaked Dark Riders who butchered his wife and children. The riders vanished into the shadows, while Fel remains in Duskwood and continues his necromancy.

faq.q: What happens after completing this quest?
aliases: next quest after proving your worth
faq.answer: After you prove your strength, Sven explains that brute force alone cannot kill Morbent Fel. He sends you to Bishop Farthing at Stormwind's Cathedral of Light to learn how to strip away the necromancer's protections.

faq.q: Where is Sven Yorgen's camp located?
faq.answer: Sven keeps a hidden camp in the hills at Duskwood's far northwestern edge. It lies north of Raven Hill and west of the road to Westfall.

angles.text: In western Duskwood, regular Stormwind patrols are absent and anarchy has taken hold. As an Alliance champion, you can help frontiersmen like Sven push back the undead.
As a paladin, you can bring the Light's justice to Raven Hill Cemetery and cleanse the restless dead of Morbent Fel's magic.
As a priest, you can answer the desecration of Raven Hill's tombs with spiritual cleansing and end the warders and healers' corruption of life and death.
